data.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum fall as crypto derivatives... | Pluang
data.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices declined by 2.24% and 1.62% respectively amid a 12.92% drop in crypto derivatives trading volume, indicating reduced risk appetite among traders. The broader crypto market saw losses across major altcoins, reflecting a defensive stance, while decentralized finance (DeFi) showed relative strength with increased trading volume. Stablecoin activity slightly decreased, suggesting a cautious approach to near-term buying power. This combination points to traders waiting for clearer market signals before increasing exposure.
